edits.new:
if independent_review["verdict"] == "FIX_REQUIRED":
                    self.review_failures += 1
                    issues = independent_review.get("issues", [])
                    blocking_gate = str(independent_review.get("gate", "") or "")
                    self.logger.emit(
                        "review",
                        "Unabhängiger Review fordert Korrekturen.",
                        cycle=self.review_failures,
                        issues=issues,
                        summary=independent_review.get("summary", ""),
                        blocking_gate=blocking_gate,
                    )
                    if self.review_failures >= self.max_review_cycles:
                        if blocking_gate == "ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID":
                            self.logger.emit(
                                "review",
                                "Deterministisches Acceptance-Gate bleibt nach allen Review-Zyklen offen; "
                                "finaler LLM-Schiedsrichter darf es nicht überstimmen.",
                                error_code="ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID_AFTER_RETRIES",
                                cycle=self.review_failures,
                                issues=issues,
                            )
                            raise AgentError(
                                "ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID_AFTER_RETRIES: "
                                f"Acceptance-PASS blieb nach {self.review_failures} Review-Zyklen "
                                "deterministisch unbelegt. Kein Commit/Push zulässig: "
                                + "; ".join(issues[:6])
                            )
                        adjudication = self._adjudicate_review(
                            issues,
                            str(independent_review.get("summary", "")),
                        )
